metadata.description: The brio-probe vertical with two local seats: the 'head' row's lone camera socket carries no seat, so it is seat-relative — one instance per occupied seat, labeled head@1/head@2 by probe.status. This machine carries one BRIO, so only seat 1 (the default-seated camera) ever gets a live instance; a second seat that joins with no camera of its own shows a seat-relative instance idle with a no-camera-assigned fault, never a crash or a silently-shared reading.
metadata.title: BRIO Seats
